analytics_fields.name: id
analytics_fields.description: Unique id of this routing decision row.

analytics_fields.name: recorded_at
analytics_fields.description: Ingest time. The export is ordered and paged on this, not on requested_at.

analytics_fields.name: requested_at
analytics_fields.description: Event time of the routed turn. Can move backwards within a page.

analytics_fields.name: request_id
analytics_fields.description: Router request id. One request id can span several rows (retry, failover).

analytics_fields.name: trace_id
analytics_fields.description: Trace id correlating this decision with emitted spans.

analytics_fields.name: session_id
analytics_fields.description: Client session id, when the client supplied one.

analytics_fields.name: rollout_id
analytics_fields.description: Client-supplied rollout identifier used to join benchmark tasks and rewards.

analytics_fields.name: device_id
analytics_fields.description: Client device id, when the client supplied one.

analytics_fields.name: client_app
analytics_fields.description: Calling application as reported by the client.

analytics_fields.name: turn_type
analytics_fields.description: Turn classification: main_loop, tool_result, probe, title_gen, compaction, classifier, recap, sub_agent_dispatch. Filter on main_loop to count user-visible turns.

analytics_fields.name: user_id
analytics_fields.description: Router-assigned end-user id, stable within the installation.

analytics_fields.name: user_email
analytics_fields.description: End-user email as supplied by the client.

analytics_fields.name: user_account_uuid
analytics_fields.description: End-user account uuid as supplied by the client.

analytics_fields.name: requested_model
analytics_fields.description: Model the caller asked for.

analytics_fields.name: decision_model
analytics_fields.description: Model the router served.

analytics_fields.name: decision_provider
analytics_fields.description: Upstream provider that served the turn.

analytics_fields.name: route_id
analytics_fields.description: Identifier of the routing decision path.

analytics_fields.name: routing_strategy
analytics_fields.description: Routing strategy that selected the served model.

analytics_fields.name: policy_route_key
analytics_fields.description: Stable route key emitted by the active routing policy.

analytics_fields.name: cluster_router_version
analytics_fields.description: Version of the cluster router that scored the turn.

analytics_fields.name: candidate_models
analytics_fields.description: Models the router considered for this turn.

analytics_fields.name: chosen_score
analytics_fields.description: Score of the served model within the candidate set. Comparable within a row, not across rows.

analytics_fields.name: decision_reason
analytics_fields.description: Free-form diagnostic prose explaining the decision. NOT a stable enum: the format changes between router versions, so do not parse it.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_arm
analytics_fields.description: Effective blind experiment arm: router_on or passthrough. Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_assignment_source
analytics_fields.description: Whether the effective experiment arm came from automatic allocation or a manual override. Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_subject_key
analytics_fields.description: Canonical subject key used for the experiment assignment. Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_mode
analytics_fields.description: Experiment mode the arm came from: user, cohort, or session. Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_session_key
analytics_fields.description: Opaque credential-scoped client session key the arm was drawn from. Null outside session mode or when the client sent no session id.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_experiment_id
analytics_fields.description: Frozen cohort experiment identifier; null on legacy installations.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_group_id
analytics_fields.description: Fixed group number for the linked roster member.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_phase_index
analytics_fields.description: Scheduled phase at request time.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_revision
analytics_fields.description: Immutable schedule revision used at request time.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_scheduled_arm
analytics_fields.description: Assigned treatment before an operator override.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_treatment_applied
analytics_fields.description: Whether the scheduled cohort treatment was in effect; false on a force-model, hard-pin, usage-bypass or undispatched turn. A client-named model still counts as applied here; use blind_experiment_treatment_applied for whether the treatment chose the model.

analytics_fields.name: cohort_bypass_reason
analytics_fields.description: Why scheduled treatment did not apply (including unassigned or disabled identities).

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_model_source
analytics_fields.description: What chose the served model on an experiment turn: router, experiment_passthrough, client_model_passthrough, routing_policy_passthrough, hard_pin, force_model, usage_bypass or not_dispatched. Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_treatment_applied
analytics_fields.description: Whether the assigned arm's treatment chose the model (router on router_on, experiment_passthrough on passthrough). Null outside an active experiment.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_baseline_model
analytics_fields.description: Model the client would get without routing: the requested model, or the client default for an automatic-routing alias or an unknown model id. Null outside an active experiment, or for an automatic-routing alias from a client with no default.

analytics_fields.name: blind_experiment_model_changed
analytics_fields.description: Whether the served model (decision_model, after any retry) differs from blind_experiment_baseline_model. Null outside an active experiment, when the turn was not dispatched, or when there is no baseline.

analytics_fields.name: policy_pin_requested
analytics_fields.description: True when the caller sent an x-weave-policy-pin header. Null when no pin was requested.

analytics_fields.name: policy_pin_honoured
analytics_fields.description: True when the turn was served by exactly the pinned policy artifact and roster. False when the pin was ignored (installation not authorized) or unservable. Null when no pin was requested.

analytics_fields.name: sticky_hit
analytics_fields.description: True when the turn reused a session-sticky decision instead of scoring fresh.

analytics_fields.name: failover_used
analytics_fields.description: True when the first-choice upstream failed and another served the turn.

analytics_fields.name: cross_format
analytics_fields.description: True when the request was translated between API formats (e.g. Anthropic to OpenAI).

analytics_fields.name: error_class
analytics_fields.description: How the turn failed: rate_limited, invalid_request, auth_rejected, model_not_found, upstream_4xx, upstream_5xx, stream_cut, stream_stalled (the router's stream watchdog ended a stalled stream), timeout, client_canceled, routing_refused, refusal, max_tokens, invalid_tool_args or other. Null on a normal completion.

analytics_fields.name: failure_owner
analytics_fields.description: Who owns the turn's failure: provider (timeouts, 5xx, overload, stalled or cut streams, refusals, 400/422 on a body the router sent unchanged), router (routing or policy outages, impossible translations, setup errors, 400/422 on a body the router rewrote), client (cancellation, oversized context, invalid request, unknown forced model, spend or credit limits, org configuration) or unknown. Null on a normal completion.

analytics_fields.name: estimated_input_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Input tokens estimated at decision time, before the upstream reported actuals.

analytics_fields.name: input_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Input tokens reported by the upstream.

analytics_fields.name: output_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Output tokens reported by the upstream.

analytics_fields.name: cache_creation_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Tokens written to the upstream prompt cache.

analytics_fields.name: cache_read_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Tokens served from the upstream prompt cache.

analytics_fields.name: cache_creation_1h_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Share of cache_creation_tokens written with the 1-hour TTL, priced at cache_write_1h_multiplier from /v1/analytics/models. Null when the turn wrote no cache or predates the column.

analytics_fields.name: reasoning_tokens
analytics_fields.description: Share of output_tokens spent on reasoning; already included in output_tokens and priced at the output rate. Null when the upstream does not break reasoning out (Anthropic) or the row predates the column.

analytics_fields.name: speed
analytics_fields.description: Serving speed the upstream reported (e.g. fast); fast turns are priced at the binding's fast rate. Null when not reported.

analytics_fields.name: inference_geo
analytics_fields.description: Inference geography the upstream reported; "us" applies us_inference_geo_multiplier to every token category. Null when not reported.

analytics_fields.name: subscription_served
analytics_fields.description: True when the turn used included Claude/Codex subscription quota. Paid Claude overage is false, even if the OAuth credential served the turn.

analytics_fields.name: credential_source
analytics_fields.description: Winning credential source; null when attribution was not recorded.

analytics_fields.name: subscription_account_id
analytics_fields.description: Stable physical subscription account that served the request; null for request-local OAuth and API capacity.

analytics_fields.name: subscription_owner_id
analytics_fields.description: Verified subscription owner; distinct from the requesting subscriber for shared capacity.

analytics_fields.name: subscription_tier
analytics_fields.description: Winning subscription tier: personal or shared.

analytics_fields.name: intended_model_family
analytics_fields.description: Canonical family selected before subscription alternatives.

analytics_fields.name: final_model_family
analytics_fields.description: Canonical family that served the request.

analytics_fields.name: actual_input_cost_usd
analytics_fields.description: Input cost of the model that actually served the turn. 0 when subscription_served.

analytics_fields.name: actual_output_cost_usd
analytics_fields.description: Output cost of the model that actually served the turn. 0 when subscription_served.

analytics_fields.name: api_rate_input_cost_usd
analytics_fields.description: Input cost of the served turn at API rates. Equals actual_input_cost_usd unless subscription_served.

analytics_fields.name: api_rate_output_cost_usd
analytics_fields.description: Output cost of the served turn at API rates. Equals actual_output_cost_usd unless subscription_served.

analytics_fields.name: route_latency_ms
analytics_fields.description: Time spent choosing a model.

analytics_fields.name: upstream_latency_ms
analytics_fields.description: Time spent waiting on the upstream provider.

analytics_fields.name: total_latency_ms
analytics_fields.description: End-to-end time for the action.

analytics_fields.name: ttft_ms
analytics_fields.description: Time to first token on a streamed response.

analytics_fields.name: upstream_status_code
analytics_fields.description: HTTP status returned by the upstream provider.

analytics_fields.name: upstream_finish_reason
analytics_fields.description: Finish reason reported by the upstream provider.

analytics_fields.name: stop_reason
analytics_fields.description: Normalized stop reason for the turn.

analytics_fields.name: tool_use_blocks
analytics_fields.description: Count of tool-use blocks in the response.

analytics_fields.name: invalid_tool_args_blocks
analytics_fields.description: Count of tool-use blocks whose arguments failed to parse.

analytics_fields.name: subscriber_plan
analytics_fields.description: Router subscription plan that admitted the turn.

analytics_fields.name: entitlement_version
analytics_fields.description: Monotonic subscriber entitlement version used for admission.

analytics_fields.name: capacity_source
analytics_fields.description: Capacity that funded the turn: included_router, linked_claude, linked_codex, prepaid, or billing_override.

analytics_fields.name: retail_usage_usd_micros
analytics_fields.description: Retail value of the served model usage in USD micros, independent of funding source.

analytics_fields.name: included_usage_usd_micros
analytics_fields.description: Retail usage funded by included Router allowance; null for other capacity sources.

analytics_fields.name: linked_usage_usd_micros
analytics_fields.description: Retail usage served by a linked Claude or Codex subscription; null for other capacity sources.

analytics_fields.name: prepaid_usage_usd_micros
analytics_fields.description: Retail usage funded by subscriber prepaid balance; null for other capacity sources.

analytics_fields.name: settlement_failed
analytics_fields.description: Whether included-allowance or prepaid settlement failed after serving. Null when no Router settlement applies.

analytics_fields.name: serving_profile_id
analytics_fields.description: Server-owned Router profile used to serve the turn.

analytics_fields.name: serving_profile_version
analytics_fields.description: Immutable revision of the server-owned Router profile.

analytics_fields.name: serving_release_id
analytics_fields.description: Verified serving release identifier.

analytics_fields.name: serving_binding_id
analytics_fields.description: Verified serving binding identifier.

analytics_fields.name: serving_target
analytics_fields.description: Managed serving target that admitted the turn: staging, prod/stable, or prod/weave-internal.

analytics_fields.name: boost_optimizer_version
analytics_fields.description: Boost source optimizer version used for selection.

analytics_fields.name: policy_artifact_id
analytics_fields.description: Routing policy artifact identifier.

analytics_fields.name: policy_artifact_sha256
analytics_fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the routing policy artifact.

analytics_fields.name: roster_version
analytics_fields.description: Immutable routing roster version.

analytics_fields.name: selection_policy_release_id
analytics_fields.description: Selection-policy release identifier.

analytics_fields.name: selection_policy_sha256
analytics_fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the selection policy.

analytics_fields.name: client_git_head_sha
analytics_fields.description: Client-reported HEAD sha of the tree a trial-mode session started from, abbreviated as the client printed it (compare by prefix). Stamped on the session's first turn only; null elsewhere.

analytics_fields.name: client_git_branch
analytics_fields.description: Client-reported branch of the tree a trial-mode session started from. First turn only; null elsewhere.

analytics_fields.name: client_git_dirty
analytics_fields.description: True when the client-reported starting tree had uncommitted changes. Null when not captured, so null and false are distinct.
